## Speaker
Du Pei

### Theme
On Boundary Conditions and Phases of Quantum Field Theories (2)

### Abstract
We will continue the study of infrared massive phases via the homotopy type of the space of boundary conditions. This time, we will focus on a class of 2d TQFTs with time-reversal symmetry and describe the space of their boundary conditions as a KO-module. An interesting ingredient in the story is a Z_8-valued generalization of the Frobenius-Schur indicator.
